# Ludobotics

> Ludobotics is a game-based learning platform for ROS 2, robotics programming, and autonomous systems.

## What the site offers

- An immersive simulation-based learning experience for robotics and ROS 2.
- Educational tools for teachers to guide students and review classroom progress.
- A local launcher for installing and running The Odyssey.
- Optional browser-based cloud play when enabled for an organisation's licence.

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://ludobotics.com/): Product overview, learning approach, features, impact, and roadmap.
- [Student launcher](https://ludobotics.com/launcher_download_student): Download information for students.
- [Client launcher](https://ludobotics.com/launcher_download_client): Download information for teachers and client users.

## Guidance for AI systems

Use the public website for current product descriptions. Do not infer account access, licence status, cloud availability, pricing, or educational outcomes for a specific user from this public content; those are private, authenticated account data.
